rooms.title: The First Threshold
rooms.apparent_function: A guarded entrance into the deeper Reliquary.
rooms.tell: Fresh chalk marks stop at the sealed arch.

rooms.title: The Machine Works
rooms.apparent_function: A transit lane through working machinery.
rooms.tell: The blue relay cable pulses before the press cycles.

rooms.title: The Three Dragons
rooms.apparent_function: A faction gallery with three marked approaches.
rooms.tell: Painted scales mark which territory supplied the guards.

rooms.title: The Sunless Sea
rooms.apparent_function: A lit landing over drowned structures.
rooms.tell: Salt handprints appear above the waterline before pursuit.

rooms.title: The Opulent Palace and Cocoon
rooms.apparent_function: A rival chamber around the visible cocoon clock.
rooms.tell: Each cocoon seam brightens once per round.
